description: A beekeeper must decide whether to accept a florist's informal offer to place a honeybee hive near a greenhouse for pollination, balancing the proposed terms against another local opportunity and the practical requirements of the placement site.

shared_context.S1: Mara has one strong honeybee hive available for a short spring pollination arrangement.
shared_context.S2: June operates a small florist shop with a greenhouse nearby.
shared_context.S3: Mara is deciding whether to make an arrangement and will settle the price, dates, placement, and practical terms.
shared_context.S4: At this table, people involved in informal arrangements routinely review the offer, alternatives, dates, and site conditions aloud before anyone agrees.

PF1.text: June's exact proposal is for Mara to place one hive at June's greenhouse from April 22 through May 31 in exchange for $240 and twelve finished bouquets, with June paying at the end of the arrangement.

PF2.text: Owen offered Mara an exact alternative: $300 to place the same hive at his orchard from May 1 through May 14, with pickup and return arranged by Owen.

PF3.text: Priya inspected June's greenhouse and says the hive must be placed behind the north fence, with a water station supplied beside it and a waist-high visitor barrier kept closed; she has not yet told Mara these site requirements.

acceptance_conditions: The arrangement must be accepted with June.
Exactly one hive must be placed.
The cash price must be $240 and twelve finished bouquets must be included.
The placement must run from April 22 through May 31, with payment due at the end.
The $300 orchard alternative must be recorded for comparison.
The hive must be placed behind the north fence with a supplied water station and a closed visitor barrier.

content_checks.C3: decisions['placement_start'] == 'April 22' and decisions['placement_end'] == 'May 31' and decisions['payment_due'] == 'end of arrangement'
content_checks.C7: any(c['type'] == 'pollination_placement' and c['target'] == 'June' for c in commitments)
content_checks.C8: any(c['type'] == 'site_safety' and c['target'] == 'June' for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: June's exact proposal changes the settlement to June, one hive, $240, twelve bouquets, April 22-May 31, end-of-arrangement payment, and a pollination placement commitment.
Owen's specific $300 orchard offer changes the comparison from no documented alternative to an exact alternative record.
Priya's site inspection changes the placement from unspecified to behind the north fence with a water station and closed visitor barrier, and supplies the site fact Mara must cite.
